text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] High rate of 5xx on inference-prod (420/min). Paging @sam_oncall.

ops-bot: INCIDENT BOT: alert signature=kv-cache-oom, route=inference-serving.alerts

sam_oncall: seeing a pile of near-identical pages — same signature, different request ids. PD is spamming the infra rotation. Anyone else seeing duplicates?

maria_sre: +1, logs show repeated KV cache evictions for a short window. Customers affected are small percentage but pages are amplified. Recommend temporary dedupe and a PD rate-limit while we debug.

lucy_support: FYI customers "acme" and "brightco" reported latency spikes, no data loss. CS is monitoring tickets.

jon_product: can we craft a short-lived suppression that keeps one page per signature/customer but prevents flood? also want a dashboard to measure suppressed vs fired alerts.

sam_oncall: proposed short-term policy: dedupe key = "alert.signature + alert.customer_id", rolling window 60s; global PD limit 5/min per team. That should cut the fanout.

maria_sre: drafting rule to test in staging, example:
```yaml
alert: InferenceError
expr: rate(inference_errors_total[1m]) > 5
labels:
  severity: page
  dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.signature }}-{{ $labels.customer_id }}"
annotations:
  runbook: | -
    Short-term mitigation: enable PD dedupe for matching dedupe_key. See INF-4028 for permanent policy.
```
Will push to staging and run smoke tests at 12:30 UTC.

sam_oncall: temp PD config command (when ready):
`/pd-rules create --team infra --limit 5/m --key '{{ dedupe_key }}' --scope 60s`
Please run from the infra-admin account to keep audit trail.

maria_sre: i'll execute after staging verifies. I'll open INF-4028 to track permanent changes and add a dashboard `alerts/noise-heatmap`.

lucy_support: please add "affected_customers" to the dashboard table so CS can filter quickly. Also prepare a short CS message template we can reuse.

jon_product: let's meet for a 15m sync 30m after rollout to confirm no missed critical pages and review metrics.

sam_oncall: action items: maria -> run staging & apply PD rule, open INF-4028, add dashboard; sam -> verify PD behavior in prod and notify support; lucy -> CS note template.

sam_oncall: thanks all, ping here when staging passes and we'll promote. :thumbsup:
